opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society (Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow members). Postgraduate, Full and Fellow member applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend.
opportunities.summary: Funding to attend a Society and/or Society-sponsored conference. Covers registration for the conference(s) applied for, attendance at the meeting dinner(s), and a contribution toward advanced standard travel and accommodation up to the total value of the award. Members can apply to attend up to three meetings with one application.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society. The applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education. Applications for 2026 are now closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society. The applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Applications for 2026 are now closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow of The Physiological Society.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events. The next application round is now open.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers who are members of The Physiological Society.
opportunities.summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential. Funds may be used for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship or other justifiable sundries (not staff salaries). The next application round is now open.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow of The Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address the principles of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion. Intended for projects that directly investigate or address inclusion and diversity issues in the physiological sciences in either teaching or research. Applications have closed for 2026 and will reopen in 2027.
